contentHtml:
Sick of the pushy sales pitch at the big tech stores? Based in Stretton with sourcing reach right across Australia, I act as your personal tech shopper. Tell me how you work, play or study, and I go looking through trusted national suppliers for the right laptop or desktop at the best price, instead of steering you toward whatever is on the shelf or whatever earns the biggest commission.

In-store, you get what is on the shelf

After a good laptop or desktop without settling for the leftovers at JB Hi-Fi, Harvey Norman or The Good Guys? Retail staff sell what they have in stock, not necessarily what suits you, and commission can nudge you toward the model that pays the best bonus rather than the one that fits.

I shop nationally, you get exactly what suits you

I source devices from across Australia, so you get the specs you actually need, nothing bloated, nothing missing, often for the same money or less than the retail "special". I will also point you at free or one-off-cost software so you are not locked into pricey subscriptions on top.

Matched to what you use it for

  • Students. Light, long battery life, and compatible with the software your course expects.
  • Gamers. The right GPU, a fast display and cooling that can keep up.
  • Business. Reliable, well-built machines that will last, with the ports and security you need.
  • Everyday use. A dependable laptop for email, browsing and the family, without paying for power you will never touch.

Want something built to spec instead? See my new computer build service, and I can have your new machine set up and ready to go when it arrives.

Send me the details for a quote or call 0477 319 160, with no call-out fee anywhere on Stretton.
